costComparison.preview: purchase-cost input hover/focus shows nearby viewport-clamped portal preview from the SAME costComparison matrix; Escape dismisses; no additional requests or writes; excluded from print
costComparison.source: WebRaumPnlItem.CostPrice, not arrival reference price or WebRaumCostPrice latest learned value
costComparison.scope: active WebRaumPnl, exact selected OrderYear and PartnerCode; latest MajorWeek first
costComparison.identity: positive ProdKey + normalized Unit; if both rows lack ProdKey, exact whitespace-normalized ItemName + Unit; custom rows kept separate
costComparison.missing: null/empty is absent; explicit zero remains zero; differing prices within one week are all shown without averaging
costComparison.refresh: detail open, partner/year change, successful settlement save, explicit retry; stale responses ignored
costComparison.export: comparison excluded from Excel and print; existing calculation and export payloads unchanged

purchaseCostManagement.shillaCombinedDisplay: same positive ProdKey + normalized Unit + IsCustom appears on the same product row with independent shared Raum/Choimun and Shilla week subcells; different units and unmapped Shilla names stay separate; only actual week cells render; each partner keeps its own quantity, sale price and amounts; a failed request is visibly failed, never labelled absent
purchaseCostManagement.shillaWriteSeparation: Shilla uses only its existing isolated cost endpoint; SHARED_PARTNERS and shared snapshot/transaction remain Raum+Choimun only; no copy/average/implicit conversion; separate drafts and save buttons
purchaseCostManagement.display: one combined Raum+Choimun matrix for the exact selected OrderYear, compressed per product row: product rows preserve the newest existing estimate's saved Seq then ItemKey order (new identities first encountered in later available estimates append in that source order) and are never alphabetically resorted; only the MajorWeek cells that actually have data render, newest first and packed with no blank filler columns; each populated cell has one shared editable purchase cost and separate read-only Raum/Choimun SalePrice, Qty, purchase amount, and SaleAmount; a mismatch visibly lists every distinct stored cost under its partner name beside the input; distinct prices are never averaged; missing partner rows are shown as absent rather than created
purchaseCostManagement.identity: OrderYear + MajorWeek + positive ProdKey + normalized Unit + IsCustom; if ProdKey is absent, exact whitespace-normalized ItemName (trailing (사입)/사입 suffix stripped for matching only) + Unit + IsCustom; PartnerCode is deliberately excluded from the shared cost identity
purchaseCostManagement.writeScope: for the selected OrderYear+MajorWeek+identity, update CostPrice/CostSource on every existing matching WebRaumPnlItem row under active Raum and Choimun masters, then update only those touched parents; never create a missing item or settlement
purchaseCostManagement.concurrency: client snapshot contains every displayed Raum+Choimun matching ItemKey/PnlKey/PartnerCode/old CostPrice; server locks both partner scopes and compares the complete current matching set before any write; any added, removed, moved, or changed row returns 409 and the whole request rolls back
purchaseCostManagement.zeroAndEmpty: explicit 0 is a valid saved cost; empty clears CostPrice to NULL and excludes the item from P&L totals
purchaseCostManagement.learning: WebRaumCostPrice is preserved so a historical week edit never changes the next import default
nearMissFixtures: one partner added the product after preview

consignedCostLinking.helper: lib/raumPnlConsignedCost.js — pure, no DB access; shared by pages/raum/pnl.js (live edit), lib/raumPnl.js (single-week save and multi-week import save/preview), and lib/raumPnlCostComparison.js (shared purchase-cost matrix identity)
consignedCostLinking.rule: an ordinary WebRaumPnlItem row and its IsConsigned(사입) counterpart never merge Qty/SalePrice/SaleAmount/IsConsigned — only CostPrice links, by exact whitespace-normalized ItemName with a trailing (사입)/사입 display suffix stripped for matching only, plus exact Unit
consignedCostLinking.fill: a blank consigned CostPrice is copied from ordinary (non-custom, non-consigned) rows sharing that identity only when they carry exactly one distinct cost value; a manually entered or legacy existing consigned cost is always preserved; a prior auto-linked cost follows a later unique ordinary-cost edit; multiple differing candidates are never averaged or guessed
consignedCostLinking.propagation: editing an ordinary row's CostPrice in pages/raum/pnl.js immediately fills a blank or refreshes an auto-linked matching consigned row in the same document; the same pure helper re-applies right before every server save so reopening, re-uploading, and merge all keep the same result
preserve: ProdKey identity for rows that have one
